Messages.Author: Zsolko
Messages.Body:
Massassi's Honor

Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Osebo
Only usable when this Osebo is blocked (play before combat, if any).
Choose a ready untapped Osebo you control who could take that action,
put this card in play, and move any other cards this Osebo !!!
played!!! this action from your ash heap to this card. After this
action, the chosen Osebo must attempt the same action (with the same
target, if any). He or she may play cards from this card as if from
your hand. Burn this card at the end of that action or if the action
is not possible.

Osebo1: plays an Ambush, he is blocked, plays a Crocodil Tongue, the
opponent cancels the card by burning bloods
Osebo2: plays Massassis Honor
Osebo1: enters combat (as result of block), plays a lot of combat
cards

QUESTION 1

Osebo2 must do the Ambush against the same vampire ?

QUESTION 1 / A

What if the original target is no longer tapped
(request from Ambush)

QUESTION 2

Can I move the combat cards played during combat (after first block)
on Massassis Honor and play them in combat when Ambush will succesful

QUESTION 2 / A

Can I play those combat cards even if the Ambush
will be second time blocked (in resulting combat)

Then the action is no longer possible.

> QUESTION 2
> Can I move the combat cards played during combat (after first block)
> on Massassis Honor and play them in combat when Ambush will succesful

No. Card text: "play before combat ... move any other cards this Osebo played
this action ... to this card". "played", not "plays".

> QUESTION 2 / A
> Can I play those combat cards even if the Ambush
> will be second time blocked (in resulting combat)

Moot.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Asnek wrote:


A minion may not attempt to take an action that is not possible.
Card text says what to do if the action is not possible.

> and one more question:
> if target will be valid, Osebo B will enter combat. as he will be
> playing again action Ambus. can be the second one Directed?

It targets another Methuselah's minion, so it is directed. It must be.

> i know that direct heve to be played immediately but as Osebo B is
> attempting the same action he have to play the same card (as it is
> placed on massasiss honor and not in ash heap)

He has to play the Ambush to take the action. That play can be canceled with
appropriate cards, like Direct Intervention, yes.
